files.docs/configuration.md:
# Configuration

This repository retains its existing ChatGPT bootstrap lineup. Automatic command discovery with bare `kogen init` works with any supported signed-in discovery route, including Claude Code and Anthropic, and does not require a ChatGPT account; configuration-first bootstrap below remains available. Shape checks its role, Refine checks Shape, and Build/resume checks Build and Review; unused providers need no login.

Bare init discovery works with any supported signed-in discovery route, including Claude Code and Anthropic, and does not require a ChatGPT account. No preset command, init provider selector or automatic router is added.
